abstract: “We are pleased to present Marie-Eve Bilodeau,” said SMPTE Montréal Chair Denis Bonneau. “She has been involved in our chapter since 2018. From day one, she took on many responsibilities and carried them to the finish line with passion and success. Marie-Eve is an important part of our team and an inspiration for others to join and make their place in our industry.”
